notes: Thin-paper black-ink sheet, author’s circled 1 at top right and pencil foliation 11. The top sketches the subgroup-rank relation, a three-loop bouquet and a hatched triangle labelled 0,1,∞. The lower part describes a colimit-preserving functor from π-sets, its associated right π-object, the balanced-product construction and a Hom adjunction, then decomposes a π-set into orbits.

The parenthetical category has a primed π. The heavily retraced input to Ens is left π|E; the mathematical role favors π but does not make all strokes separable. In the Hom formula the old E and replacement Y are both readable. The large outer closing parenthesis is partly clipped at the right edge, yet both its upper and lower portions survive, so both closing parentheses are retained. The first product brace is visibly short, ending before E; no semantic conclusion is drawn from that short extent.
hand: In this thinner black hand an opening parenthesis may be almost a straight slash; the primed π in the side annotation is still separated by a short raised tick.
